comments.body:
Hi @Dtenwolde this is possibly because you have an outdated extension. 
Can you try to run `UPDATE EXTENSIONS` or `FORCE INSTALL ui` and be sure you have the latest version, `963e0e4`?

Let me know if it helps.

title: Support for Executing Python code in Notebook
body: Hi there! I wanted to inquire if we can add a feature to execute Python code in the notebook.
author: soumilshah1995

comments.body: This is not something we plan to support. The UI is focused on DuckDB, not Python, and adding Python would be a substantial expansion of scope.
When/how did that happen? Was it datadog?

> When/how did that happen? Was it datadog?

Unrelated to datadog. This addresses a hypothetical attack, where a malicious web site could send a request to the UI server running on localhost and run SQL.

I thought this was disabled by CORS, and it is by default, but it turns out you can pass `mode: 'no-cors'` to `fetch` to circumvent that. But, the browser still sets `Sec-Fetch-Site` to `cross-site` in that case, so blocking requests with that addresses this case.
Ah yes. I misread the condition. Thanks!
